text:
Ava: Quick UX snag from user testing: action buttons in the metrics table feel cramped when toasts appear in the top-right. Hover tooltips are clipped and keyboard focus ring sometimes gets hidden. Fig: https://figma.com/file/qwerty
Jon: Hmm. Are we using compact spacing tokens there? Those shrink the cell padding and the visible focus area. For accessibility we need at least a 44px hit target on touch breakpoints.
Marta: Suggestion: collapse secondary actions into a kebab at <=480px and keep a single primary icon visible. For desktop keep full actions but increase cell padding slightly or use icon-only buttons with clear aria-labels.
Devon: Also, layering order: toasts currently float over tooltips. That's confusing. We should define layer tokens: token.layer.modal=10000, token.layer.tooltip=9500, token.layer.toast=9000 so tooltips win over toasts.
Ava: Good call. I'll update Figma to show tooltip above toast and update examples with focus outline visible when compact spacing is applied.
Jon: For modals + toasts interaction: if a modal is open, toasts should be visually de-emphasized and not steal focus or keyboard events. They can exist but shouldn't respond to global Esc. Scope Esc to the active topmost component.
Marta: Copy nits: change "More" labels to "More actions" for screen readers inside table rows. Also shorten inline toaster copy: use "Saved" or "Upload failed 1 Retry" rather than full sentences.
Devon: Motion accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion for toast entry/exit and tooltip fades. Also avoid layout shifts by absolutely positioning toast container.
Ava: For keyboard users we should avoid auto-focusing primary buttons after a toast dismiss. Instead, leave focus where it was and announce the toast via role=status aria-live=polite.
Jon: For implementation: 1) add layer tokens, 2) adjust spacing.density tokens (rename compact-* to density.compact-*), 3) tooltip portal above toasts, 4) kebab collapse at small breakpoints, 5) Esc scoping. I'll open a PR with code samples.
Marta: A11y checklist request: I'll write a short list for QA: keyboard nav on table rows, tooltip description via aria-describedby, screen reader phrasing checks, mobile tap targets, reduced-motion verification. Will post tomorrow.
design-bot: Preview updated: https://deploy.preview/changes-456 680 (shows tooltip/topology + new tokens)
Ava: Thanks all 1 I'll add the updated frames and examples to the component docs and ping eng for the PR review.
